items.title: How specific does the cause need to be before people stop needing help?
items.description: Take the password-field example from this unit: 'Invalid input' vs. 'Passwords need at least 8 characters, including one number.' This is a simplified, illustrative model (not measured data) of how the share of users who fix the problem on their own, without contacting support or giving up, tends to rise as an error message's stated cause gets more specific — from a bare 'invalid' at one end to naming the exact rule at the other. Drag the slider to see the effect.
